name: Weilerswist (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically white and black, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Weilerswist (a tower and an eagle on white and black).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Cologne of 4 May 1972 the municipality was granted the right to bear arms and a flag (banner), described as white and black striped lengthwise 1:1 with the municipal arms slightly above the centre.
